The project

915 Avenida Pico,
San Clemente.

A freestanding former restaurant in Plaza Pacifica, listed for lease by Parker & Associates, Inc. We shot and retouched the drone and interior photography, cut a property film, designed an eleven-page brochure, and built the property page on the brokerage website.

Property
±4,500 SF former restaurant · ±0.68 acres
Listing
Parker & Associates, Inc.
Scope
Photography, retouching, film, brochure & property website
01

Photography

Drone footage and interior photos, with stills pulled from the 4K video for the overhead, front and side views.

02

Retouching

Prior tenant signage, caution tape, litter and parked work trucks removed, with the lighting evened out.

03

Brochure

Eleven pages with a site map, kitchen equipment, traffic, drive times and demographics.

04

Website & film

A property page on digitalre.com with the 3D tour, and a 42-second property film.

01 / The website

Property website.

A property page on the Parker & Associates, Inc. website with the film, the 3D tour, the kitchen, a traffic diagram, drive times and demographics. Inquiries go to the leasing team.
